_comment: Dynamics / reward shifts on Hopper-v4, Ant-v4, Humanoid-v4: 14 conditions x 3 envs x 5 seeds = 210 runs.
That is more than one 188-slot node: submit two jobs with SHARD=1/2 and SHARD=2/2 (105 runs each),
or drop conditions / seeds to fit one node.
Each experiment without an `env` is run on every env in `envs` (with that env's paper hyperparameters);
`per_env` gives env-specific overrides. Keys starting with _ are comments.
Conditions 1-6 are the baselines: constant settings for 12M steps, so each reaches its peak.
Conditions 7-12 are splits that switch at 6M between `base` and one of the baseline physics conditions,
using exactly the same settings as those baselines, so the two halves can be compared against them.
Conditions 13-14 also switch the termination bounds mid-run (schedule `env_kwargs`, set in place on the env).
Videos: n_eval episodes every video_every steps, at each switch (just before it) and at the end.
Friction note: MuJoCo uses the max of the two touching geoms' friction, so `friction_scale` (all geoms) is used
rather than lowering the floor alone (Hopper's foot is 2.0 and would dominate).
